blocks.text: Heavy metals such as lead, mercury and cadmium can be significant air pollutants. They are released into the atmosphere by industrial processes, transport and other human activities; metallurgy, battery waste and incineration are their major sources.

blocks.prompt: What are the major sources of heavy metals in the atmosphere, and describe the sources of lead and mercury pollution (Quick Check 14.2d; exercise Q.2m).
blocks.explanation: Metallurgy (smelting and refining ores), the waste and recycling of batteries, and the incineration of waste, together with transport and other industry. Lead comes from lead smelting, lead-acid battery recycling and historically from leaded petrol; mercury from coal burning, mercury-containing wastes and incineration, and from metal and chlor-alkali industries.

items: Heavy metals Pb, Hg, Cd from metallurgy, battery waste, incineration, transport and industry.
